scripts.build:web: STATIC_HOSTING_BASE_PATH=/ VITE_GROAM_SHELL=web bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.build:web:desktop: STATIC_HOSTING_BASE_PATH=/ VITE_GROAM_SHELL=desktop VITE_CONVEX_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3210 VITE_SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3211/ bun run --cwd apps/web build
scripts.check: bun run audit && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run react-doctor && bun run fallow
scripts.codegen: bun run codegen:routes && bun run codegen:auth && bun run codegen:convex
scripts.deploy: bun run convex:deploy && bun run migrations:run:prod && bun run hosting:upload:web:prod
scripts.fallow: bunx fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --fail-on-issues && bunx fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc health --css
scripts.fallow:changed: bunx fallow audit -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --changed-since HEAD --gate all && bunx fallow security -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --changed-since HEAD --gate new
scripts.fallow:strict: bunx fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc --fail-on-issues --type-aware-require complete && bunx fallow -c tooling/fallow.config.jsonc health --css --type-aware-require complete
scripts.hosting:upload:web: static-hosting upload --component web --dist apps/web/dist --build-command 'bun run build:web'
scripts.hosting:upload:web:desktop: static-hosting upload --component web --dist apps/web/dist --build-command 'bun run build:web:desktop'
scripts.hosting:upload:web:prod: static-hosting upload --prod --component web --dist apps/web/dist --build-command 'bun run build:web'
scripts.lint: bun run lint:conventions && bun run lint:packages && vp check
scripts.showcase: bun run seed -- --scale realistic && bun run --cwd tooling/showcase showcase
scripts.test: bun test --path-ignore-patterns apps/desktop/src-tauri tooling/quality && vp run --fail-if-no-match --filter "@groam/*" --cache --concurrency-limit 2 test
